review_scope: Independent static source review of eight core owner-wiki pages, prioritized save/load, keyboard dispatch and debug commands. No repository source edits; no full game acceptance run claimed.

findings.status: parent corrected; independently re-read corrected pages
findings.finding: F10 directly generates a region with terrain-only arguments, replaces active actors with the player and does not call the modern complete scene-entry route.
findings.recommended_text: Recommend M or debug F4, move the overmap cursor, then Enter for current debug travel. Group F10 with F5 and unshifted F8 as legacy disposable helpers, not G6 scene ownership acceptance checks.

findings.status: parent corrected; independently re-read corrected page
findings.finding: For a non-header use/equip row, engine._advance_turn() is unconditional after item_system.use unless a pending confirmation or throw target is opened. The boolean return means item consumed, not action success.
findings.recommended_text: Navigation is free. Ordinary use/equip can spend a turn even when failed, no-op or unconsumed. Opening wight confirmation or pellet targeting is free; their resolution and transfer/placement guards have separate contracts.

verified_claims: Engine explicit full save occurs on nondebug F5 in local play; no current debug console save command.
Current surface/stair travel scene-cache writes do not replace explicit published checkpoint saving; quit does not save.
Shipped DEBUG_MODE is True; F9 in debug prints state, while nondebug F9 loads.
F4 reveals overmap and sets OVERMAP mode; overmap Enter calls current teleport route only in debug.
F3 sets explored cells and is not removal of FOV/light rules.
Movement arrows/numpad, wait Z/period/KP5, sprint Shift+W, unshifted W drink, Q/R movesets, G harvest/gather/pickup, comma pickup and M surface guard match dispatch.
Debug dispatch follows death and pending-consume guards and precedes most other screens.
Checkpoint payload version 2 and outer container version 1 are distinct from world-generation plan revisions.
Loading considers published references, not arbitrary generation-directory scan; legacy flat supported v2 saves have a read-only compatibility path.
Disposable launcher names have a bounded alphanumeric/underscore/hyphen contract, refuse existing sessions, patch SAVE_DIR, and run production source.
Core tool command flags were checked against parser definitions; this is static CLI review, not execution of every command.

source_link_check.method: Pinned SHA equality plus URL-decoded repository-path existence

additional_discrepancies_documented: Regular weather ticking and graphics stop in submaps, but fog FOV caps, AI modifiers, bone-snow tile entry and cracked-bell weather modifiers lack matching submap guards.
A JSON weather entry alone does not add a usable state; state-machine and Engine render-dispatch wiring are required.
Bone snow has no incoming ordinary transition from another weather state.
Active world-generation wrapper overwrites helper myth locus selection with VUKH.
Myth god/faction strings are stored and debug-displayed; no automatic narrative interpolation or faction simulation consumer found.

Biome generator, creature_zones, submap_types/weight, overmap fields, entry/resonance messages and waystone themes/fallback flag have no matching current runtime consumers; actual decisions use code tables and explicit handlers.
Clay scatter allows adjacent extra deposits beyond four primary placements; its docstring total cap is inaccurate.
